title: Ghast Jockey
description: Ghast Jockey! Fight this new foe which is a combination of a fiery ghast and fierce piglin.
body:
# Disclaimer
This datapack only works for snapshots 25w16a and above since the leash changes can only be found there.

## Description
Ghast Jockey! is a Datapack which uses the new leash mechanics from 25w16a in order to recreate the jockey from A Minecraft Movie which is are piglins using ghasts as a war platform. Play the Minecraft movie now at your own copy.

> GHAST JOCKEYYYYY
> - Steve

![Ghast jockey in action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a907702c60b2150b00d129bc34781455a82a544.png)

## Command

```
/function carried_ghast:spawn_carried
```
Use this command to manually spawn the ghast jockey!
